_archetype.name: IGT Triple Double Diamond (Hot Roll base reels; bonus slot replaced with Cherry to preserve Blank/non-Blank alternation)
_archetype.source: Wizard of Odds reverse-engineered reel mapping (https://wizardofodds.com/games/slots/hot-roll/)
_archetype.confidence: medium-high — expert reverse-engineering, not IGT official PAR sheet
_archetype.modifications_from_archetype: Hot Roll bonus trigger positions (R1[13], R2[15], R3[13]) replaced with Cherry — M1 has no bonus, and replacing with Blank would create 3-consecutive-blank chains (pos 12/13/14 on R1/R3, pos 14/15/16 on R2). Per project_slot_designer_strips_weights_layout.md alternation is universal rule (Harrigan near-miss band), so we substitute Cherry (lowest-pay symbol = least pay-table disruption) at the would-break positions to keep strict B/N alternation. Result: 22 stops with 11 Blank + 11 non-Blank alternating B-N-B-N... pattern on all 3 reels.

_invariants: 22 physical stops per reel; shared symbol layout (position -> symbol) is byte-identical across all modes — only per-mode weights vary.

Blank / non-Blank STRICT alternation on all 3 reels (B-N-B-N-... pattern from pos 0 to pos 21). 11 Blank + 11 non-Blank per reel. NO 3-consecutive-blank or 3-consecutive-non-blank chains anywhere. Universal rule per project_slot_designer_strips_weights_layout.md (Harrigan near-miss band).
Reel 1/2/3 have INDEPENDENT non-blank symbol sequences (classic IGT convention — each reel's symbol order is tuned for its own dramatic role).
Bonus-trigger positions (R1[13], R2[15], R3[13]) substituted with Cherry rather than Blank — only deviation from WoO Hot Roll virtual mapping.

_symbol_role.Diamond1: Double Diamond (2x wild) — substitutes any symbol except Cherry and self; multiplier 2x
_symbol_role.Diamond2: Triple Diamond (3x wild) — substitutes any symbol except Cherry and self; multiplier 3x
